Name: Akira's Portrait-Accurate Alex (1.6)
Author: ikeychain
Description:
A mod that makes it so that Alex's world sprite looks more similar to his portrait.

[list]
[*]Makes his hair scruffier and messier.
[*]Gives him an open jacket.
[*]Makes him a little tanner
[*]Adds more detail to his Winter outfit.
[/list]
[b]This mod is not available anywhere else but Nexusmods.com, if you see it somewhere else it is likely taken without permission.

[/b]Follow me on [url=https://x.com/iKeychain]Twitter[/url]﻿ & [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ikeychain.blog]Bsky[/url]! I've been drawing Abigail art for a decade! [b][u]
